title: Functional Outcome of Urethral Reconstructive Surgery
brief_summary: The analysis of the long-term outcomes and quality-of-life parameters after urethral reconstruction surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* male
* urethral stricture surgery
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* loss of follow-up
* not willing to participate
study_population: All patients who underwent urethral reconstruction in our center from 2009 to this date
